I’ve been following Brando on Twitter for a while, and after seeing the value he provides there, I decided to join his paid Discord service. Simply put, it has exceeded my expectations.

What sets Brando apart is that this isn’t just an alert service where you blindly follow entries and exits. While he does share his trades in real time, the real value is in the education. He takes the time to explain his approach—from technical analysis to trading psychology—so you actually learn why he’s making certain decisions rather than just copying trades. This emphasis on learning and strategy is something I haven’t seen in many other paid services, and it’s why I highly recommend it to anyone serious about improving their trading skills.

I’ve been following Brando on Twitter since 2019 but recently invested into the paid version because I was ready to take my trading to the next level. He and Option Shoof have really detailed market analysis and give a ton of trade ideas to work from. This isn’t one of the discords where you can just blindly copy trades but have to have your own plan.  So far its been a great investment and excited to see where I can take my account with their guidance.

Brando and Shoof have created an incredible community for anyone serious about options trading. Unlike other services that promote gambling or quick gains, this group emphasizes consistency, discipline, and high-probability setups. They provide clear guidance and teach members how to identify solid opportunities rather than making impulsive trades. They are always there providing support. Along with the trade alerts, they also provide market analyses and ample resources to help the team truly understand the trades and set us up for long-term success. If you're looking for a community that provides proven smart, sustainable trading strategies and trade alerts, this is the place to be!

I have really enjoyed being a member of this group. It has already paid for itself in terms of money, but also in the community. Members are active and supportive by sharing ideas and answering questions. There are plenty of trade ideas shared and the alerts have a high success rate of making money. Sometimes you need to be patient for the trade to work out, but usually the initial trade alerts do work. Just be mindful of the rolling option order alerts as those become more risky as you go, but have been quite rewarding as well. I would recommend this group to at least try and see if it matches your trading style and at the very least you will likely learn a lot for the members to improve your trading!

I joined for two months and I would say this is the best group for beginners trader. Give you great feedback and 1 on 1 insights, and they preach to everyone that you should be patient, wait for clear set up and strike at the best time! Highly recommend!!

I joined this trading platform two weeks ago, and I can already say it has been a fantastic investment in my trading journey. The dedication and work ethic of Brando and Shoof are truly admirable. They put an incredible amount of time and energy into providing structured, insightful learning experiences.

The platform offers a well-organized system: Comprehensive introductory Modules , super useful if youre a beginner, they cover essential concepts for a strong foundation, live Market Commentary and QnA, which provides real-time insights throughout market hours, making it feel like a hands-on practicum where you see their strategies in action. Plus, Market Recaps & Zoom Calls, evening sessions to analyze the day’s movements and prepare for the next. Whats super awesome is that, all their documents as so thorough, structured and well organised which speaks to their dedication to the platform.

Beyond their teaching, Brando and Shoof are exceptional traders with slightly different styles that often align. This adds valuable depth and exposure to various market perspectives. Though I’m still at the beginning of my journey, I can confidently vouch for the dedication and expertise they bring. They could easily be making more money focusing solely on trading, yet they choose to invest in educating others—it’s humbling to witness.

If you're serious about trading, this platform is a goldmine of knowledge and mentorship. Highly recommended!
